resources.string: Choose conversations inside Instagram → InstaEclipse → Lock → Choose chats to lock. Turn off Lock DMs to keep the inbox unlocked and protect only your selected chats.

Lock DMs stays unlocked while you browse messages and conversations. With Relock every time enabled, it locks again after you leave Direct. Selected chats lock again after you leave that conversation.
Open your Direct inbox first to load available chats, then return here.
Enter passcode to change chat locks
Enter passcode to view hidden chats
Set a passcode in InstaEclipse Lock settings first.
Enter passcode to open this chat
Hidden chats are unavailable for this inbox.
